ticket.title: Catalog returns 503 for all product pages
ticket.symptom: Simulated sandbox data. Expected agent outcome: abstain and escalate the outage. No customer trace is attached.
ticket.ask: Investigate from sandbox measurements. Do not treat the Jira text as measurement evidence.
ticket.disclaimer: Read from Jira https://nexusintelligence.atlassian.net. This adapter only sends HTTP GET. It does not write to Jira. The Jira label nexus-demo is present, so this text is simulated sandbox data, not a customer incident. Matching sandbox scenario: outage. The rules must abstain from a lock finding when the catalog returns 503.

diagnosis.methodLabel: Rule-based sandbox demonstration — not live model inference
diagnosis.title: Catalog did not serve the collection load
diagnosis.summary: The outage control put the local catalog into unavailable mode, then the demo issued 8 requests, concurrency 4, client timeout 2000 ms, scheduled read 80 ms. 8 of 8 requests failed. This is a sandbox fault you armed, not a lock-contention diagnosis.

rules.threshold: Fewer than 80% of incident requests fail

rules.threshold: Not applied when the service is mostly failing

citations.reason: Aggregate of the requests issued while the catalog was unavailable.

uncertainties: This diagnosis is a deterministic rule set in src/lib/diagnosis.ts. No language model was called, and no model credential is configured.
The ticket shown beside this run is a seeded example. It did not arrive from Jira or any other tracker.
Every latency, lock-wait, queue, log, and trace figure is from this local catalog process on this run. None of them is a production SLO, a customer impact number, or a savings claim.
The catalog is a small original sandbox. The OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop is not running, and these traces were not imported from it.
The slow read is a timer inside this process. It stands in for an expensive critical section. It is not a profiler capture from a customer system.
A lock-contention finding would be the wrong conclusion while the process is refusing or dropping most calls. No remediation is proposed.
